title: sectora
description: Threat intel + your scans/findings/Shield posture. CVE, EPSS, KEV, package vuln lookup, DAST.
summary: Threat intel + your scans/findings/Shield posture. CVE, EPSS, KEV, package vuln lookup, DAST.
offersHint: Threat intel + your scans/findings/Shield posture. CVE, EPSS, KEV, package vuln lookup, DAST. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.sectora.io/mcp

toolsPreview.name: lookup_cve
toolsPreview.description: Get full threat intelligence enrichment for a CVE including EPSS score, CISA KEV status, public exploits, Nuclei templates, risk level, and risk factors. Input must be a valid CVE ID.

toolsPreview.name: assess_tech_risk
toolsPreview.description: Assess security risk for a list of technologies. Returns known CVEs affecting each technology with severity breakdown. Input: comma-separated technology names only.

toolsPreview.name: search_cves
toolsPreview.description: Search for CVEs by keyword, severity, or other filters. Query must be alphanumeric text.

toolsPreview.name: get_kev_recent
toolsPreview.description: Get recently added entries to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.

toolsPreview.name: get_trending_cves
toolsPreview.description: Get currently trending CVEs based on recent KEV additions, high EPSS scores, and exploit availability.

toolsPreview.name: get_weaponization_score
toolsPreview.description: Get the weaponization score (0-100) for a CVE. Factors in EPSS, KEV status, exploit availability, Nuclei templates, and CVSS. Input must be a valid CVE ID.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_ip_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Look up community IP reputation from Sectora Shield WAF network. Shows if an IP has been reported for attacks. Accepts IPv4 or IPv6 (the Shield network sees both).

toolsPreview.name: get_threat_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get statistics about the Sectora threat intelligence database including counts of EPSS scores, KEV entries, Nuclei templates, and exploits. No input required.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_findings
toolsPreview.description: List the API key owner's open security findings across all scans. Use this to answer "what's my current exposure?" Filter by severity, status, or domain. Returns finding summaries; call get_scan for full detail. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_scans
toolsPreview.description: List the API key owner's recent scans with summary counts. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_scan
toolsPreview.description: Get a scan with all its findings (full detail: title, description, evidence, remediation, CVSS). Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: scan_url
toolsPreview.description: Kick off a DAST security scan against a public URL the API key owner controls. Two-step flow: first call returns a preview (target, profile, ETA, quota remaining); confirm by calling again with confirm:true to actually start the scan. Returns scan_id; poll status with get_scan. Domain must be verified in the Sectora account. Daily quota: 25 scans/24h per user. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_posture
toolsPreview.description: Get Shield WAF posture score and breakdown for a domain registered under this account. Returns 0-100 score, letter grade, per-component breakdown (origin lock, virtual patching, TLS, etc.), and edge_health (whether Shield is actually intercepting traffic). Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: assess_dependency
toolsPreview.description: Check a single package@version for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, crates.io, etc.). Returns advisories with CVE IDs, severity, fixed versions, and references. Free tier eligible.
